name: chatbot
description: Visitor chatbots for third-party websites. Each chatbot is a non-interactive Elowen account of kind chatbot bound to exactly one managed Project, and visitors reach it through the customer's own website. The widget posts to the public hook /hooks/chatbot/v2, the plugin issues a server-signed visitor token, and every admitted message starts a real Elowen turn owned by that chatbot account through the host relay. The plugin never calls a model itself.

configSchema.label: Visitor sessions
configSchema.hint: How long an anonymous visitor may keep talking before the website has to ask for a new visitor token.

configSchema.label: Visitor token lifetime (days)
configSchema.hint: A visitor token is the only authority an anonymous visitor has. When it expires the widget asks for a new one and the conversation continues in the same session; a token is never extended automatically.
